description: Fields parsed from the Arena WebDev leaderboard (Next.js serialized entries JSON) into the schema-versioned snapshot.

models.<id>.note: Snapshot is flat (no provider envelope): {schema_version, source:{url,fetched_at}, models}. id is the normalized model id from name_matching.normalize_arena_name. fetched_at is preserved from the previous snapshot when models are unchanged (byte-stable daily runs).

arena_score.parse: rounded to 2 decimals; highest rating wins per model_id

effort.note: extracted from the display name by normalize_arena_name (e.g. 'high'/'low'); null when absent

join_rule: arena.json stays keyed by normalized Arena id; joining to OpenCode model ids happens only in models-mapping build_mapping.py, never here.
